answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a bond that is slashed when its attestations are proven false, sized so a farm of fake identities costs more than it earns. Like a comet crossing a meadow, one bright signal stands out against background noise: honest agents build a public history of useful work, while throwaway identities stay thin and cheap-looking. Weight votes and payouts by that attested history, not by headcount.
